opening.comment: The agent's first turn is not shown as a greeting with their own name and the company name; the transcript only shows the word Tidewell, and the agent's first actual line does not introduce them.

verification.quote: Can I have your full name and order number or postcode?
verification.comment: Good job asking for the full name and order number before discussing the order; the caller provided both.

understanding.quote: So you're asking when the €75.00 comes black?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the refund question accurately, though the restatement is garbled and the agent should confirm the issue clearly.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Refunds take 10 two 14 working days after we receive the item, so until be another week or two.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy says a refund is paid within 5 working days of the return arriving at the warehouse, so the stated 10 to 14 working days is incorrect and the agent should have checked the 5-day timeline.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: You'll get an email the day it's paid.
process_compliance.comment: The return was for a mirror at EUR 75 and the refund was discussed, but no hold or photo/label step applied; no required steps were missed on this call.

communication.quote: Agent: Thanks for calling, Ahmed, have a good afternoon.
communication.comment: The agent was polite, but when the caller said they were worried, the agent only said I understand at the start and did not clearly acknowledge the concern in the rest of the call.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get an email the day it's paid. as there anything else I can help you which?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next step, asked if there was anything else, and closed politely, though the wording of the question was unclear.
